mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ocr_job WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ocr_job WHERE file_id=#{fileId} AND provider=#{provider}
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_job SET state='QUEUED',error_code=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='FAILED'

UPDATE ocr_job SET state='QUEUED',candidate_json=NULL,error_code=NULL,review_version=review_version+1,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND review_version=#{version} AND state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')

WITH expired AS (SELECT j.id FROM ocr_job j WHERE j.provider='MOCK_V1' AND j.state='RUNNING' AND j.lease_until<now() AND j.attempts>=#{maxAttempts} AND (j.intake_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM case_file f JOIN work_order w ON w.id=f.work_order_id WHERE f.id=j.file_id AND w.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))) ORDER BY j.lease_until,j.id FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 50) UPDATE ocr_job j SET state='FAILED',error_code='LEASE_EXHAUSTED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() FROM expired e WHERE j.id=e.id
mapper.select: WITH next AS (SELECT j.id FROM ocr_job j LEFT JOIN case_file f ON f.id=j.file_id LEFT JOIN work_order w ON w.id=f.work_order_id WHERE j.provider=#{provider} AND (j.intake_id IS NOT NULL OR w.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')) AND (j.state='QUEUED' OR (j.provider='MOCK_V1' AND j.state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<now() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_quote_ocr_scope s WHERE s.job_id=j.id))) AND ((NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_quote_ocr_scope s WHERE s.job_id=j.id) AND attempts<#{maxAttempts}) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_quote_ocr_scope s WHERE s.job_id=j.id) AND (attempts=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_quote_ocr_rerun rr WHERE rr.job_id=j.id AND rr.attempt=j.attempts+1)))) ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE ocr_job j SET state='RUNNING',attempts=j.attempts+1,lease_token=#{token},lease_until=now()+make_interval(secs=>#{seconds}),updated_at=now() FROM next WHERE j.id=next.id RETURNING j.*
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_job SET state=CASE WHEN #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,candidate_json=#{candidate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},error_code=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR},lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>now()
UPDATE ocr_job SET review_version=#{version}+1,candidate_json=#{candidate},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND review_version=#{version} AND state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT candidate_json,revision FROM ocr_review WHERE job_id=#{id} AND command_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_confirmation VALUES(#{id},#{version},#{actor},now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ocr_confirmation WHERE job_id=#{id} AND revision=#{version}
SELECT count(*) FROM ocr_review WHERE job_id=#{id}

SELECT r.revision,r.candidate_json,r.actor_id,r.created_at,c.actor_id AS confirmed_by,c.created_at AS confirmed_at FROM ocr_review r LEFT JOIN ocr_confirmation c USING(job_id,revision) WHERE r.job_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.revision DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
